tools.name: vectorize_image
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an image converted to SVG or vector (vectorize, trace, image to SVG): a logo, an icon, an illustration, a picture from an AI tool. tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Use this when vectorize_image answered that a conversion is still running, to read how it stands and its figures.

tools.name: get_svg
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the finished SVG file itself, to save or use it. It never spends a credit. tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many VecSnap credits they have left.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Only the VecSnap card calls this. It answers where to send the image the person dropped.

tools.name: start_conversion
tools.description: Only the VecSnap card calls this. It starts a conversion and answers at once, so the card can show it.

tools.name: read_card
tools.description: Only the VecSnap card calls this. It answers how a conversion stands, its picture and its figures.

tools.name: unlock_file
tools.description: Only the VecSnap card calls this. The person pressed Download: it spends one credit from their VecSnap account, once per image, and answers the file's link.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "vectorize_image" is 771 chars, far longer than this server's median (108). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
